shared_contract.identity: Record the shared recognition and scope, if any, plus what is intentionally allowed to vary.
shared_contract.navigation: Keep destination labels, relative order, current-page state, landmarks, and keyboard behavior consistent.
shared_contract.truth: Replace with the claim, source, date, uncertainty, disclosure, and correction contract.
shared_contract.accessibility: Replace with the semantic, focus, contrast, reflow, input, and assistive-technology contract.
shared_contract.voice: Replace with shared terminology, cultural authority, and route-level language boundaries.
shared_contract.performance: Replace with budgets, measurement context, fallbacks, and ownership.

routes.title: Replace with the route title
routes.user_job: Replace with the job this route performs for a visitor.
routes.creative_logic: Describe this route in its own terms. A singular, plural, conventional, restrained, maximal, ornamental, or experimental logic may be valid.

observable_decisions.decision: Replace with a consequential rendered decision rather than a required design category.
observable_decisions.reason: Explain why it suits this route, content, audience, and constraints.
observable_decisions.evidence: Replace with a source, proof artifact, rendered observation, or explicit provisional limit.

routes.responsive_result: Describe the route result at project-derived widths and inputs; do not assume a generic desktop-to-stack transformation. Replace every unresolved capture width below before implementation or review.
routes.reduced_motion_result: Describe the complete reduced or no-motion result when motion exists; otherwise state that no motion dependency exists.
routes.no_javascript_result: Describe the complete source-visible result and any honestly unavailable enhancement.

routes.title: Replace with the second route title
routes.user_job: Replace with the distinct job this route performs.

creative_logic.logic_statement: Describe the route without filling a standard list of typography, color, media, interaction, or energy fields.
project_specific_evidence: Replace this key and value with whatever structure helps this project explain the decision.

observable_decisions.decision: Replace with the decision that most distinguishes the rendered body from route-a.
observable_decisions.reason: Explain why the difference belongs to the route job.
observable_decisions.evidence: Replace with proof or mark the decision provisional.

routes.responsive_result: Describe the actual responsive behavior relevant to this route and replace every unresolved capture width below with a project-derived value.
routes.reduced_motion_result: Describe the reduced-motion result or the absence of a motion dependency.
deliberate_differences: Record one observable body-level difference from route-a and the project reason for it.

cultural_acceptance.notes: This neutral template defaults to not-required. Set required to true when actual cultural or community context triggers review; only an eligible independent authority can accept a required review.
